text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered: KMS.DecryptFailures > 50/min across us-west-2 clusters. Triggered rule: kms-decrypt-throttle-high. PD alert: PD-INC-8442

alex: got the page, looking. seeing a bunch of 429s in logs from inference-router.

maria: confirmed. dashboards show decrypt error rate spike starting ~1785004200, matches PD window. Latency for token generation also climbs.

siva: any recent key rotations? HSM team rolling key-rotations for service keys this morning.

alex: checking key metadata now... `r_infer_prod_2024_v2` last-rotate at 1784970000 according to kms metadata. no recent automated rotation in last hour.

kevin: I see increased ThrottlingException on KMS RPCs in us-west-2 from the inference pool. qps looks ~3x expected.

maria: stack traces in router show failed decrypts bubbling up to user requests: `KMS.DecryptException: KeyNotFound` sometimes, but mostly `Throttling`.

alex: paste of sample log lines: ```
2026-03-14T15:12:18Z inference-router[22]: ERROR decrypt failed: ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded
2026-03-14T15:12:19Z inference-router[22]: WARN fallback to cached kvs for session abc123
2026-03-14T15:12:20Z inference-router[22]: ERROR decrypt failed: KeyNotFoundException: key r_infer_prod_2024_v2 not found
```

maria: customer impact: in-flight hosted API calls are returning 5xx or increased latency. Fresh sessions requiring decrypt of model keys are failing. Older cached sessions continue serving for a bit.

siva: mitigation plan idea: 1) add short-term token-serving fallback to previously cached key material (force use of cache), 2) rate-limit outgoing KMS calls per-node and implement jittered backoff, 3) notify HSM/KMS infra to check throttling quotas.

kevin: I can push a tiny router patch to catch ThrottlingException and switch to cached prefixes + 429->retry with exponential backoff. Estimate 8-12m to rollout canary.

alex: we should also update routing policy to divert non-prod traffic off the impacted pool. Can we throttle PLG/free tier?

maria: yes, routing config has per-customer tier flags. I'll open a quick rollout to update route weights: move 30% of PLG traffic to us-east endpoint.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-INC-8442 auto-escalation in 10m if unacked.

alex: I've assigned the PD incident to myself and acked. `pagerduty:ack`

pagerduty: Acknowledged PD-INC-8442 by alex. Next escalation in 10m to oncall+1.

kevin: pushing canary with catch for ThrottlingException now. CI build passed. Deploying to 3 nodes. logs: `deploy canary router-v3.5.1-canary`

maria: rolling route change to shift PLG traffic to us-east: `infra routing update --service inference --from us-west-2 --to us-east-1 --pct 30`

alex: manual mitigation steps recorded: 1) patch catch & fallback (kevin), 2) route shift (maria), 3) contact kms-infra (siva), 4) prepare handoff notes for next oncall.

siva: pinging kms-infra: @kms-infra-team please confirm if there's global throttle or a regional token bucket bump.

kms-infra (via email-bot): we've seen a surge in requests from a customer integration testing. We are increasing soft limits for your account and inspecting HSM queue depth. Expected relax in ~5-10m.

kevin: canary logs show reduced decrypt failures on canary nodes, fallback working. sample: `INFO decrypt fallback-used for session abc123, success`

maria: after route shift, overall decrypt error rate dropped ~65% on the main graph. latency back down to baseline for most calls. still seeing occasional KeyNotFound errors for a tiny % of requests.

alex: KeyNotFound ones look correlated to sessions that referenced ephemeral keys from rotation window. we should validate rotation state. siva can you confirm if any rotation jobs failed?

siva: checking rotation job history: one rotation job for `r_infer_prod_2024_v2` started at 1785004000 and reported `partial-success` due to HSM retry. It retried but left a small set of replicas without the key. I'm opening a remedial job to re-propagate key to replicas now. ETA ~12m.

maria: customer impact update to #general and support: "We experienced transient KMS throttling causing some API errors and latency for hosted inference in us-west-2. Mitigations applied (routing shift, fallback patch). We are re-propagating keys for a small subset of replicas. Target to full recovery in ~15-20m." :info:

kevin: I'm scaling up router pool for higher concurrency to reduce burst on KMS per-node. `autoscale set inference-router --min 20 --max 60`

incident-bot: PD-INC-8442: alex updated status: mitigation in progress.

maria: preparing handoff note for next oncall at top of hour, including commands, logs, and remediation steps.

alex: quick checklist for handoff: \n- issue: KMS Decrypt Throttling + small KeyNotFound from partial rotation\n- current mitigation: catch-and-fallback patch deployed to canary -> rolling; PLG routing shift 30% -> us-east; key re-propagation in progress; kms-infra increased soft limits\n- remaining work: re-propagate keys to all replicas, verify no KeyNotFound spikes, monitor for recurrence, revert routing shift after stable 30m\n- commands: `gcloud kms keys versions list --key r_infer_prod_2024_v2 --location us-west2`, `kubectl logs deployment/inference-router -n prod --tail 200 | grep Decrypt`

siva: remedial propagation job completed for remaining replicas at 1785004550. verified keys present across replicas.

kevin: router rollout completed, canary -> full. Decrypt 429s down to normal.

maria: graphs show error rate back to baseline. We'll keep monitoring for 60m.

pagerduty: PD-INC-8442 resolved by alex.

alex: handing off to next oncall @kevin for monitoring window. Notes posted to /incidents/PD-INC-8442 with logs and timeline.

kevin: ack handoff. will watch for 60m, will escalate if error rate creeps back.

maria: filing post-incident followup with action items: 1) add per-node KMS rate limiter & token bucket calcs, 2) improve rotation job idempotency and verification, 3) add alert for KeyNotFound spike separate from throttling alert, 4) run chaos test for KMS slowdowns.

alex: thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-8442 closed at 1785004620.
